utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, I'm glad we're finally getting that repair drive going. Did you manage to gather the tools we talked about?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, sorry Mara, I got caught up with something and haven't gathered them yet. Can we do that together now?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Ah, no worries at all, I figured you might've been busy. Let's head to my shed first, I've got a good selection we can sort through.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools. Want me to look at the drive now?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, but let me double-check the model number first — I don't want us messing with the wrong hardware.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Fine. I'll wait. But check fast — I got other things to do today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Noah, I heard we're organizing a repair drive. Do you know what supplies we'll need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, um, a repair drive? Is that this weekend or next? I think I saw a flyer somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It might be next weekend; I'm not sure on the date, but I was hoping we could coordinate a list of tools and materials.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Is there anything specific you're working on?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, yes—I'm just trying to figure out how we can get enough tools and space for everyone to work without tripping over each other.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe we could set up different stations in folks' garages? Spread things out a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you actually fix the leak, or is it still dripping like last time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I think I saw them working on it yesterday—I'm not sure if they got it all fixed, though.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you didn't check yourself? I'll go take a look at it now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the repair drive they're starting down at the community center? I heard they're collecting old tools and whatnot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard about that. I was actually thinking of donating some of my old wrenches—they're gathering dust anyway.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Gus! I was planning to drop off some old screwdrivers myself—every little bit helps, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're all pitching in to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's great! Do you know if we're meeting at the main entrance or the side parking lot?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're meeting at the main entrance at 9 AM sharp!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who told you that? I haven't said anything about it yet.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, sorry—I must've mixed you up with someone else. My bad!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm so glad you stopped by—we're rallying the neighbors for the upcoming repair drive and could really use your help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Rosa, yeah I heard something about that. What do you need me to chip in?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we're looking for folks to help patch up fences and fix some porch steps—I know you're great with tools, Bo. Could you lend a hand next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, did you hear we're planning a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I sure hope it's in the morning—I like to have my day sorted before noon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Morning it is! I'll make sure to tell everyone we're starting at 9 AM sharp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... could you remind me what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some broken benches and a cracked path near the community garden. Nothing too big, but it'd be nice to get things tidy again.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, the benches near the garden! I remember now—though I could've sworn I left my wrench somewhere around there last week.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I heard you're organizing that repair drive—count me in to help spread the word around the block!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that's awesome, Jules! I could really use your help getting flyers to the folks on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I'll take a stack of flyers and start with the neighbors I know on Maple Street this afternoon!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I'm spreading the word about the repair drive—heard you might be interested in helping out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, yeah? Sounds interesting. What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're gathering at the community center this Saturday morning, fixing up fences, porches, whatever needs a hand—I'm rounding up folks for a big team effort.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard you're organizing the repair drive. I've got some tools in my garage if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's mighty helpful, Rey. Let's sort through them on Saturday morning, I like to have a system.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday morning works for me. I'll have them laid out in the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mara, do you think we should push the repair drive to next Saturday instead? I just realized it's the same day as the school bake sale.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I completely forgot about the bake sale! Yeah, moving it to next Saturday makes a lot of sense so folks don't have to choose.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll update the flyers and let the neighbors know about the change. Thanks for the quick agreement!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard about the repair drive—sounds like a great way to bring everyone together!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I was just telling Frank about it—we're gonna get everyone fixing up the park benches this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's fantastic! I can rally the neighbors from the north side to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any tools or a hand with something?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Gus, but I'm mostly worried about scheduling pickup times. If people drop off things all at once, we'll have a mess.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Tell you what, I can help with scheduling if you want—maybe set up time slots so folks don't all show up at once.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Rosa! Are you heading to the repair drive? I heard it's at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm just on my way there now! I've got a box of old toasters and a sewing machine that needs some love.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I remember the community center—it's just past the old oak tree on Maple Street, right? I hope they can fix up that sewing machine for you!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, you're working on that repair drive? Is it for the community center computer?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it is. I just want to double-check the file names before I install anything—do you know which version it needs?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think it's the 2.0 version, but you'd better ask Mark to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help with tools or setting up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, Sam! I could use help sorting through the donated tools and maybe setting up a repair station. Got any spare time this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm free Saturday morning. I can bring my toolbox and help sort through the donations.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I hadn't heard about that—can you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, a repair drive? I think I saw a flyer about it, but I can't remember the details. Something about fixing up the community center?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, the community center, that sounds right! I wonder what they're planning to fix up in there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, you're saying this drive is supposed to fix the whole neighborhood's power grid? How do you know it'll actually work?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it from George at the hardware store—he says the guy who built it used to work for the city's power company, so it's gotta be legit!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: George? The same George who told me last month that solar panels would make my roof leak? I'm not sure I'd trust his word on this.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, Uli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How's that going so far?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it's coming along... slowly. Got a few folks interested, but not as many as I'd hoped.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, I might know a couple of handy people who could help out—want me to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Leo! Good to see you. I was just thinking about that repair drive — do we need batteries or something? I can never keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mainly just tools, but batteries wouldn't hurt. Check the signup list at my garage for specifics.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the signup list! I'll wander over there... after I remember where I put my reading glasses.
